name: One&Only Mandarina
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary perched 200 feet above the Pacific showcases Mexico's untamed Riviera Nayarit coastline, where ancient rainforest meets dramatic volcanic beaches.
whats_special: One&Only Mandarina sits within a 280-acre nature reserve where jaguars still roam wild. The resort's treehouses are suspended 35 feet above ground, connected by elevated walkways that weave through the jungle canopy. Each villa features a private beach club accessible only by funicular railway carved into the cliff face.
pro_tip: Book the Mandarina Suite's helicopter transfer for breathtaking aerial views of Banderas Bay's hidden beaches and the Sierra Madre mountains – it's the only way some of these pristine coves can be seen.
dont_miss: The resort's private marine sanctuary where you can swim with wild dolphins and manta rays year-round. Visit during turtle nesting season (July-December) when Olive Ridley sea turtles come ashore just steps from your villa. The jungle spa treatments using indigenous Huichol healing rituals are completely unique to this property.
pros: Spectacular clifftop location with panoramic Pacific Ocean views
Ultra-luxury treehouses and villas immersed in pristine jungle
Exclusive private beach access and world-class spa facilities
Exceptional culinary experiences with renowned chef-driven restaurants
cons: Remote jungle location requires travel time to reach nearby attractions
